channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News, Reddit and more, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: Canvas by AgentGrid – An AI Agent Workspace for Design Files
item.description: Open a canvas in the browser, drop in Figma, web or document files, and connect Claude or other agents to work on your designs right there.

item.title: OneKDP: AI Book and KDP Cover Generator
item.description: An AI book and KDP cover generator with editable interiors, full print covers and free KDP tools.

item.title: Show HN: Learn Piano Easy App – Free and Open Source
item.description: Learn Piano Easy is a free, open-source app for teaching yourself piano.

item.title: Show HN: Anarchy Chess
item.description: A chess puzzle twist on the classic 8-queens problem, adding rooks, bishops, and knights, with fresh puzzles generated daily alongside the original 8-queens and a few static ones.

item.title: Show HN: Word Gambits, Daily Puzzle Capture Chess Pieces to Form Words
item.description: A daily puzzle: capture chess pieces to form three words, and leave just one piece on the board.

item.title: Memeo – Turn Static Photos into Lip-Synced AI Meme Videos
item.description: Upload one photo, pick a meme scene, and watch a person or pet lip-sync and act out a short skit — a shareable meme video in minutes.

item.title: Correo Desechable: Temporary Email
item.description: A free instant disposable email address with no registration, so your real inbox stays private.

item.title: Clear Rank Agent Tools: Pay-per-Call Utilities for AI Agents
item.description: Micro-utilities for AI agents, payable per call in USDC with no account or API key.

item.title: ToolRush: 200+ Free Online Tools
item.description: 200+ free online tools — calculators, converters, PDF, image and text tools — all in the browser, no sign-up.

item.title: Crop Desk: Free Photo, PDF and Document Tools
item.description: Free online photo, PDF and document tools — compress photos, make passport photos, merge and sign PDFs — files stay on your device.

item.title: ToolsKitFree: 206 Free Online Tools
item.description: 206 free online tools across image, PDF, video, audio, text, SEO and developer categories, files processed locally.

item.title: BuzzyX: AI-Powered X Growth Tool
item.description: An AI-powered X growth workspace to write posts in your own voice, schedule them and read real analytics.

item.title: AI Photo with the White Lion: Lion Portrait Maker
item.description: Upload one clear face photo and get an AI portrait with Sheru Bhai, the white lion, ready to download.

item.title: Show HN: Every Satellite in Orbit Since 1957
item.description: An interactive visualisation of every satellite launched since 1957, built from the GCAT database.

item.title: Show HN: Poker Diary, a tool to help organise your home games and track stats
item.description: Home poker games usually get organized by group-chat polls, which makes tracking players and results messy — Poker Diary puts organizing and stats in one tool.

item.title: Show HN: I built a free, Python micro-learning platform with real Python tasks
item.description: A free Python micro-learning platform built around real coding tasks, for anyone who wants to practice Python a few minutes a day.

item.title: Show HN: Shutters – Photos and More
item.description: The author's mom, a photographer and artist, didn't enjoy the existing options for storing, sharing and organizing her work — so he built her Shutters.

item.title: Show HN: The Last Complication, a Zachtronics-style watchmaking puzzle game
item.description: A Zachtronics-style puzzle game about watchmaking, for players who enjoy fiddling with gears and precise mechanisms.

item.title: Show HN: Wipeout-style mini racer written in C++ compiled to WASM for browser
item.description: A Wipeout-inspired mini racer written in C++ and compiled to WASM so it runs right in the browser, with the author sharing notes on exploring game portability.

item.title: Show HN: I rewrote Doom2D Forever in Rust, playable in browser
item.description: The author loved Doom2D as a kid and always wanted a version shareable by link — now rewritten in Rust and playable in the browser.
